paragraphs.en: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity, and Pi
paragraphs.zh: 用于 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode、GitHub Copilot、Google Antigravity 和 Pi 的多框架智能体插件市场

paragraphs.en: Use one collection of plugins, agents, skills, and commands across Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Pi. A harness is the coding tool that loads and runs the components. Plugins cover Python and JavaScript development, code review, testing, infrastructure, security, and other work.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex CLI、Cursor、OpenCode、Antigravity CLI、GitHub Copilot 和 Pi 中使用同一套插件、智能体、技能和命令。 载体（harness）是指加载并运行这些组件的编码工具。 插件涵盖 Python 和 JavaScript 开发、代码审查、测试、基础设施、安全以及其他工作。

sents.en: Use one collection of plugins, agents, skills, and commands across Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Pi.
sents.zh: 在 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex CLI、Cursor、OpenCode、Antigravity CLI、GitHub Copilot 和 Pi 中使用同一套插件、智能体、技能和命令。

sents.en: A harness is the coding tool that loads and runs the components.
sents.zh: 载体（harness）是指加载并运行这些组件的编码工具。

sents.en: Plugins cover Python and JavaScript development, code review, testing, infrastructure, security, and other work.
sents.zh: 插件涵盖 Python 和 JavaScript 开发、代码审查、测试、基础设施、安全以及其他工作。

paragraphs.en: The catalog contains 94 plugins, including 92 local plugins and 2 external entries. The local source contains 202 agents, 185 skills, and 105 commands. The components share a Markdown source, with installation and capabilities adapted to each harness.
paragraphs.zh: 该目录包含 94 个插件，其中包括 92 个本地插件和 2 个外部条目。 本地来源包含 202 个智能体、185 项技能和 105 条命令。 各组件共享同一 Markdown 来源，其安装方式和能力则根据各自的运行框架进行了适配。

sents.en: The catalog contains 94 plugins, including 92 local plugins and 2 external entries.
sents.zh: 该目录包含 94 个插件，其中包括 92 个本地插件和 2 个外部条目。

sents.en: The local source contains 202 agents, 185 skills, and 105 commands.
sents.zh: 本地来源包含 202 个智能体、185 项技能和 105 条命令。

sents.en: The components share a Markdown source, with installation and capabilities adapted to each harness.
sents.zh: 各组件共享同一 Markdown 来源，其安装方式和能力则根据各自的运行框架进行了适配。

paragraphs.en: Choose the harness you use and follow its setup route. Available components depend on the installation route and the harness's capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 选择你使用的测试框架，并按照其对应的安装路径进行设置。 可用的组件取决于所选择的安装路径以及测试框架的能力。

sents.en: Choose the harness you use and follow its setup route.
sents.zh: 选择你使用的测试框架，并按照其对应的安装路径进行设置。

sents.en: Available components depend on the installation route and the harness's capabilities.
sents.zh: 可用的组件取决于所选择的安装路径以及测试框架的能力。

paragraphs.en: See the capability matrix for model mappings, tool permissions, hooks, and installation differences.
paragraphs.zh: 请查看能力矩阵以了解模型映射、工具权限、钩子（hooks）和安装差异。

paragraphs.en: For individual skills, use a skills-only installer and select your coding tool.
paragraphs.zh: 对于单个技能，请使用仅包含技能的安装器，并选择你的编码工具。

paragraphs.en: See the plugin catalog for all 94 plugins and the usage guide for commands and examples.
paragraphs.zh: 请查看插件目录以了解全部 94 个插件，并查看使用指南以了解命令和示例。

paragraphs.en: Run these commands inside Claude Code to register the marketplace and install the Python development plugin:
paragraphs.zh: 在 Claude Code 中运行以下命令，以注册市场并安装 Python 开发插件：

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add wshobson/agents /plugin install python-development@claude-code-workflows Then ask Claude to use the Python agents for your task, or run the plugin's scaffolding command:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add wshobson/agents /plugin install python-development@claude-code-workflows 然后让 Claude 使用 Python 智能体来完成你的任务，或者运行该插件的脚手架命令：

paragraphs.en: /python-development:python-scaffold Create a FastAPI service with tests Codex CLI Run these commands in a terminal with a current Codex CLI:
paragraphs.zh: /python-development:python-scaffold 创建一个带测试的 FastAPI 服务 Codex CLI 在装有当前版本 Codex CLI 的终端中运行以下命令：

paragraphs.en: codex plugin marketplace add wshobson/agents codex plugin add python-development@claude-code-workflows The native Codex manifests expose source skills. The generated TOML agents and command-derived skills use a separate adapter path. Native installation also reads the original skill bodies, while generated copies split oversized bodies into reference files for the 8 KB budget. See the Codex setup details before choosing an installation route.
paragraphs.zh: codex plugin marketplace add wshobson/agents codex plugin add python-development@claude-code-workflows 原生 Codex 清单会暴露源技能。 生成的 TOML 智能体和由命令派生的技能使用单独的适配器路径。 原生安装还会读取原始技能正文，而生成的副本则会将超大的正文拆分为参考文件，以符合 8 KB 的预算。 在选择安装路线之前，请先查看 Codex 设置详情。

sents.en: codex plugin marketplace add wshobson/agents codex plugin add python-development@claude-code-workflows The native Codex manifests expose source skills.
sents.zh: codex plugin marketplace add wshobson/agents codex plugin add python-development@claude-code-workflows 原生 Codex 清单会暴露源技能。

sents.en: The generated TOML agents and command-derived skills use a separate adapter path.
sents.zh: 生成的 TOML 智能体和由命令派生的技能使用单独的适配器路径。

sents.en: Native installation also reads the original skill bodies, while generated copies split oversized bodies into reference files for the 8 KB budget.
sents.zh: 原生安装还会读取原始技能正文，而生成的副本则会将超大的正文拆分为参考文件，以符合 8 KB 的预算。

sents.en: See the Codex setup details before choosing an installation route.
sents.zh: 在选择安装路线之前，请先查看 Codex 设置详情。

paragraphs.en: Cursor uses the committed plugin marketplace registry . Follow the Cursor setup instructions to add the marketplace and install a plugin.
paragraphs.zh: Cursor 使用已提交的插件市场注册表。 按照 Cursor 的设置说明添加市场并安装插件。

sents.en: Cursor uses the committed plugin marketplace registry .
sents.zh: Cursor 使用已提交的插件市场注册表。

sents.en: Follow the Cursor setup instructions to add the marketplace and install a plugin.
sents.zh: 按照 Cursor 的设置说明添加市场并安装插件。

paragraphs.en: Install an individual skill with GitHub CLI's gh skill command or the npx skills installer. Select your coding tool when prompted. Both installers read skills from GitHub without cloning the repository and install them without the plugin's agents, commands, or hooks.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 GitHub CLI 的 gh skill 命令或 npx skills 安装器来安装单个技能。 在提示时选择你的编码工具。 两个安装器都直接从 GitHub 读取技能而无需克隆仓库，并且安装时不包含该插件的智能体、命令或钩子。

sents.en: Install an individual skill with GitHub CLI's gh skill command or the npx skills installer.
sents.zh: 使用 GitHub CLI 的 gh skill 命令或 npx skills 安装器来安装单个技能。

sents.en: Select your coding tool when prompted.
sents.zh: 在提示时选择你的编码工具。

sents.en: Both installers read skills from GitHub without cloning the repository and install them without the plugin's agents, commands, or hooks.
sents.zh: 两个安装器都直接从 GitHub 读取技能而无需克隆仓库，并且安装时不包含该插件的智能体、命令或钩子。

paragraphs.en: gh skill install wshobson/agents python-testing-patterns npx skills add wshobson/agents --skill python-testing-patterns gh skill requires GitHub CLI 2.90 or later. The npx command requires Node.js and npm. See skills-only installation for other agents, install scopes, and version pinning.
paragraphs.zh: gh skill install wshobson/agents python-testing-patterns npx skills add wshobson/agents --skill python-testing-patterns gh skill 命令需要 GitHub CLI 2.90 或更高版本。 npx 命令需要 Node.js 和 npm。 其他智能体的安装方式、安装范围和版本固定，请参阅仅安装 skills 的相关说明。

sents.en: gh skill install wshobson/agents python-testing-patterns npx skills add wshobson/agents --skill python-testing-patterns gh skill requires GitHub CLI 2.90 or later.
sents.zh: gh skill install wshobson/agents python-testing-patterns npx skills add wshobson/agents --skill python-testing-patterns gh skill 命令需要 GitHub CLI 2.90 或更高版本。

sents.en: The npx command requires Node.js and npm.
sents.zh: npx 命令需要 Node.js 和 npm。

sents.en: See skills-only installation for other agents, install scopes, and version pinning.
sents.zh: 其他智能体的安装方式、安装范围和版本固定，请参阅仅安装 skills 的相关说明。

paragraphs.en: For OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Pi, clone the repository and use the installer for your harness. Install uv , Python 3.12 or later, and the coding tool you want to use. The following clone command uses GitHub CLI:
paragraphs.zh: 对于 OpenCode、Antigravity CLI、GitHub Copilot 和 Pi，请克隆该仓库并使用对应工具的安装器。 安装 uv、Python 3.12 或更高版本，以及你想使用的编程工具。 以下克隆命令使用 GitHub CLI：

sents.en: For OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Pi, clone the repository and use the installer for your harness.
sents.zh: 对于 OpenCode、Antigravity CLI、GitHub Copilot 和 Pi，请克隆该仓库并使用对应工具的安装器。

sents.en: Install uv , Python 3.12 or later, and the coding tool you want to use.
sents.zh: 安装 uv、Python 3.12 或更高版本，以及你想使用的编程工具。

sents.en: The following clone command uses GitHub CLI:
sents.zh: 以下克隆命令使用 GitHub CLI：

paragraphs.en: gh repo clone wshobson/agents ~ /agents cd ~ /agents Run the command for your tool. Each target generates the artifacts and links all local plugins into that tool's user configuration:
paragraphs.zh: gh repo clone wshobson/agents ~ /agents cd ~ /agents 运行适用于你工具的命令。 每个目标会生成相应的产物，并将所有本地插件链接到该工具的用户配置中：

sents.en: gh repo clone wshobson/agents ~ /agents cd ~ /agents Run the command for your tool.
sents.zh: gh repo clone wshobson/agents ~ /agents cd ~ /agents 运行适用于你工具的命令。

sents.en: Each target generates the artifacts and links all local plugins into that tool's user configuration:
sents.zh: 每个目标会生成相应的产物，并将所有本地插件链接到该工具的用户配置中：

paragraphs.en: make install-opencode make install-antigravity make install-copilot make install-pi Pi's agents require its reference subagent extension or a compatible extension. See the global install guide for configuration paths and uninstall commands.
paragraphs.zh: make install-opencode make install-antigravity make install-copilot make install-pi Pi 的智能体需要其 reference subagent 扩展或兼容的扩展。 全局安装指南包含配置路径和卸载命令。

sents.en: make install-opencode make install-antigravity make install-copilot make install-pi Pi's agents require its reference subagent extension or a compatible extension.
sents.zh: make install-opencode make install-antigravity make install-copilot make install-pi Pi 的智能体需要其 reference subagent 扩展或兼容的扩展。

sents.en: See the global install guide for configuration paths and uninstall commands.
sents.zh: 全局安装指南包含配置路径和卸载命令。

paragraphs.en: The agent, skill, and command counts cover local source files. External plugins provide their own components and installation requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体、技能和命令的数量涵盖本地源文件。 外部插件提供它们自己的组件和安装要求。

sents.en: The agent, skill, and command counts cover local source files.
sents.zh: 智能体、技能和命令的数量涵盖本地源文件。

sents.en: External plugins provide their own components and installation requirements.
sents.zh: 外部插件提供它们自己的组件和安装要求。

paragraphs.en: A plugin groups related agents, skills, and commands under plugins/ . For example, python-development contains three agents, sixteen skills, and a scaffolding command. The chosen harness loads the installed components according to its own discovery and invocation rules.
paragraphs.zh: 插件将相关的智能体、技能和命令归组在 plugins/ 目录下。 例如，python-development 包含三个智能体、十六项技能和一个脚手架命令。 所选的运行框架会按照其自身的发现与调用规则来加载已安装的组件。

sents.en: A plugin groups related agents, skills, and commands under plugins/ .
sents.zh: 插件将相关的智能体、技能和命令归组在 plugins/ 目录下。

sents.en: For example, python-development contains three agents, sixteen skills, and a scaffolding command.
sents.zh: 例如，python-development 包含三个智能体、十六项技能和一个脚手架命令。

sents.en: The chosen harness loads the installed components according to its own discovery and invocation rules.
sents.zh: 所选的运行框架会按照其自身的发现与调用规则来加载已安装的组件。

paragraphs.en: Contributors maintain one Markdown source in the Claude Code plugin format. Native registries point to that source where supported, and adapters generate the formats needed by each harness. Commands may become skills or prompt templates, and agent formats, model choices, and tool permissions vary by harness.
paragraphs.zh: 贡献者只需在 Claude Code 插件格式中维护一份 Markdown 源文件。 在支持的平台上，原生注册表直接指向该源文件，而适配器则为每个 harness 生成所需的格式。 命令可能变成技能或提示模板，而智能体格式、模型选择和工具权限则因 harness 而异。

sents.en: Contributors maintain one Markdown source in the Claude Code plugin format.
sents.zh: 贡献者只需在 Claude Code 插件格式中维护一份 Markdown 源文件。

sents.en: Native registries point to that source where supported, and adapters generate the formats needed by each harness.
sents.zh: 在支持的平台上，原生注册表直接指向该源文件，而适配器则为每个 harness 生成所需的格式。

sents.en: Commands may become skills or prompt templates, and agent formats, model choices, and tool permissions vary by harness.
sents.zh: 命令可能变成技能或提示模板，而智能体格式、模型选择和工具权限则因 harness 而异。

paragraphs.en: Source agents specify model aliases such as opus , sonnet , haiku , fable , or inherit . Adapters map those aliases to each harness's model settings, including fixed defaults for some inherit entries. See model configuration and the adapter mappings .
paragraphs.zh: 源智能体指定模型别名，例如 opus、sonnet、haiku、fable 或 inherit。 适配器将这些别名映射到每个框架的模型设置，包括某些 inherit 条目的固定默认值。 参见模型配置和适配器映射。

sents.en: Source agents specify model aliases such as opus , sonnet , haiku , fable , or inherit .
sents.zh: 源智能体指定模型别名，例如 opus、sonnet、haiku、fable 或 inherit。

sents.en: Adapters map those aliases to each harness's model settings, including fixed defaults for some inherit entries.
sents.zh: 适配器将这些别名映射到每个框架的模型设置，包括某些 inherit 条目的固定默认值。

sents.en: See model configuration and the adapter mappings .
sents.zh: 参见模型配置和适配器映射。

paragraphs.en: The repository validates plugin structure, generated artifacts, and documentation. Contributors can run these checks from the repository root:
paragraphs.zh: 该仓库会校验插件结构、生成的产物以及文档。 贡献者可以从仓库根目录运行这些检查：

sents.en: The repository validates plugin structure, generated artifacts, and documentation.
sents.zh: 该仓库会校验插件结构、生成的产物以及文档。

sents.en: Contributors can run these checks from the repository root:
sents.zh: 贡献者可以从仓库根目录运行这些检查：

paragraphs.en: make generate-all make validate STRICT=1 make garden plugin-eval also provides static skill checks without model calls. For example:
paragraphs.zh: make generate-all make validate STRICT=1 make garden 智能体插件评估（plugin-eval）还提供无需模型调用的静态技能检查。例如：

paragraphs.en: uv run --project plugins/plugin-eval plugin-eval score plugins/python-development/skills/python-testing-patterns --depth quick The LLM judge and Monte Carlo layers are experimental and are not validated against human labels. Their scores describe model assessments and repeated simulations and do not prove that a task succeeds in a project. They require the optional llm dependencies. Model calls use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY when it is set and bill that API account. Otherwise they use your Claude Code login. See the evaluation guide for setup and limits.
paragraphs.zh: uv run --project plugins/plugin-eval plugin-eval score plugins/python-development/skills/python-testing-patterns --depth quick LLM 判定层和蒙特卡洛层是实验性功能，尚未经过人工标注的验证。 它们的分数描述的是模型评估和重复模拟的结果，并不能证明某个任务在项目中成功。 它们需要可选的 llm 依赖项。 模型调用在设置了 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 时使用该密钥，并向该 API 账户计费。 否则会使用你的 Claude Code 登录账户。 设置和限制请参见评估指南。

sents.en: uv run --project plugins/plugin-eval plugin-eval score plugins/python-development/skills/python-testing-patterns --depth quick The LLM judge and Monte Carlo layers are experimental and are not validated against human labels.
sents.zh: uv run --project plugins/plugin-eval plugin-eval score plugins/python-development/skills/python-testing-patterns --depth quick LLM 判定层和蒙特卡洛层是实验性功能，尚未经过人工标注的验证。

sents.en: Their scores describe model assessments and repeated simulations and do not prove that a task succeeds in a project.
sents.zh: 它们的分数描述的是模型评估和重复模拟的结果，并不能证明某个任务在项目中成功。

sents.en: They require the optional llm dependencies.
sents.zh: 它们需要可选的 llm 依赖项。

sents.en: Model calls use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY when it is set and bill that API account.
sents.zh: 模型调用在设置了 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 时使用该密钥，并向该 API 账户计费。

sents.en: Otherwise they use your Claude Code login.
sents.zh: 否则会使用你的 Claude Code 登录账户。

sents.en: See the evaluation guide for setup and limits.
sents.zh: 设置和限制请参见评估指南。

paragraphs.en: See CONTRIBUTING.md to propose a change and authoring conventions to write plugin content.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md 以了解提出变更的方法以及撰写插件内容的规范。

paragraphs.en: Pensyve remains an optional external Claude Code marketplace entry. Major7 Apps maintains Pensyve, and this repository's maintainer founded Major7 Apps. Its open-source runtime can run locally or on your own server. Pensyve Cloud closed on October 1, 2026 , and its dashboard, API, and hosted MCP endpoints are unavailable. Use the self-hosting guide when configuring the runtime.
paragraphs.zh: Pensyve 仍然是 Claude Code 的一个可选外部市场条目。 Major7 Apps 维护着 Pensyve，而本仓库的维护者是 Major7 Apps 的创始人。 其开源运行时可以在本地或你自己的服务器上运行。 Pensyve Cloud 已于 2026 年 10 月 1 日关闭，其仪表板、API 和托管的 MCP 端点均已不可用。 配置运行时时，请使用自托管指南。
